question: Which of the following chemicals is used as a preservative to slow browning and discolouration in foods and beverages during preparation, storage and distribution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sulphites**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Sulphites**:

 
• Sulphites are natural compounds found in foods like dried fruits, wine, and beer.
 
• They're also added as additives to prevent browning, discoloration, and spoilage in foods and drinks.
 
• Sulphites release sulphur dioxide (SO₂), an irritant gas, which can cause allergy-like symptoms in individuals with conditions like asthma.
 
• Around 13% of people with asthma also suffer from sulphite sensitivity.
